title: Access Gate Event
description: The reader reached a chapter they cannot read yet, and the app showed the way in instead of its text: buy the book, subscribe, or wait. The chapter is the context chapter. It is not reading: the chapter was not opened, so no chapter_transition or heartbeat follows from it.

gate.description: What stands between the reader and the chapter. `purchase`: the book has to be bought. `subscription`: a subscription is needed. `wait`: the chapter opens by itself after a delay.

signed_in.description: Whether the reader had an account signed in when the gate was shown.

unlocks_at.description: Only for `wait`: when the chapter opens by itself.
